say:1:1231187001:1.text: No such thing as idle hands on the dock now.
say:1:1231187001:1.source_cn: 现在整个码头的搬运工就没有闲着的。

say:2:1231187002:1.text: Even if we work day and night, it's impossible to catch up on all that needs to be done.
say:2:1231187002:1.source_cn: 可就算我们没日没夜的干，现在的活儿还是干不完。

say:3:1231187003:1.text: The foreman is already looking for a repairman to inspect the lift! It seems many parts have rusted from not being used for so long.
say:3:1231187003:1.source_cn: 工头已经在找维修师检修升降机了！之前升降机太久没用，好...

say:4:1231187004:1.text: My hope is that it'll ease our workload once it's up and running.
say:4:1231187004:1.source_cn: 希望升降机投入使用后，能缓解我们的工作强度。
